title: Space Shuttle Engines Could Drain a Pool in 25 Seconds

scenes.text: Shuttle engine pumps could drain a swimming pool in twenty-five seconds.
The shuttle had three main engines. They burned liquid hydrogen at minus 423 degrees Fahrenheit.
Inside the combustion chamber, it reached about 6,000 degrees.
The fuel pump alone put out the power of 28 locomotives.
Together, the three engines made about as much power as 23 Hoover Dams.
A swimming pool, empty in twenty-five seconds.

description:
A space shuttle's engine pumps could empty a family swimming pool in about 25 seconds.
The fuel pump alone matched the power of 28 locomotives.
Would you have watched a shuttle launch in person?
